messages:
maria: Quick sync — legal just sent back AcmeCorp's checklist. They want explicit data access controls, per-tenant KMS with BYOK option, and 7 years of audit logs. Need product position by EOD so sales can sign the pilot.

sam: 7 years is rough. infra cost + storage grows linearly. We currently keep 1 year of hot audit logs and archive 3 years cold; 7 years would need separate archival/legal pipeline.

jess: From a compliance POV, SOC2 + their industry (financial services) expect long retention. Also they require proof of key separation for BYOK — HSM-backed customer keys.

lee: Acme says SLA must include cryptographic access guarantees and proof of key deletion when contract ends. That's a hard ask for Hosted product.

maria: Options: 1) Offer Dedicated/Private only with 7-yr & BYOK + escalation to Legal for contract wording, 2) Offer hosted with 1yr default + paid add-on for extended retention and BYOK (limited functionality), 3) Decline the 7yr/BYOK request for pilot. Thoughts?

sam: Tech tradeoffs: Dedicated/Private gives us isolated KMS and export controls — doable. Hosted BYOK (multi-tenant) is risky unless we bake customer key isolation and HSM integration. Timeline 2-3 sprints for hosted BYOK.

jess: Also need audit log schema: immutable tamper-evident logs + signed daily digests. That satisfies auditors. Can we commit to signed digests for hosted while we build full HSM BYOK?

maria: That feels like a viable phased approach: promise signed-digest auditing + 3yr archival in hosted + dedicated for full 7yr/BYOK.

lee: Sales wants explicit launch criteria they can share: (a) documented KMS model + threat model, (b) audit digest proof-of-concept, (c) contract language for key custody. Anything else?

sam: Add performance SLA: no >200ms median for inference under Dedicated; for hosted, we should call out best-effort and capacity-based fallbacks.

jess: And add compliance docs: SOC2 control mapping for audit logs and key management. Legal-bot, can you flag any non-starter clauses?

legal-bot: Not a blocker in principle. BYOK with HSM ok, need contractual clauses on key escrow (if any), deletion verification, and incident response timelines. 7yr retention ok if export controls and e-discovery provisions handled.

ops-bot: Note: retention config prototype (for discussion):
```
retention: {
  hosted: {hot: 365d, cold: 3y, signed_digests: daily},
  dedicated: {hot: 365d, cold: 7y, BYOK: true}
}
```

maria: Action items: Sam + EngInfra estimate cost + timeline for hosted BYOK and 7yr archive by EOD; Jess to draft SOC2 mapping + digest spec; Legal to propose contract wording for key deletion/escrow. Lee to prep sales-facing one-pager with the phased offer. We'll present to Acme tomorrow. :thumbsup:

lee: On it. I'll include pricing options and the phased commitment language.

sam: I'll ping infra for HSM provider options and slot a quick tech review.

jess: Draft started, will drop in this thread before EOD.

maria: Thanks team. If we can't meet the 7yr BYOK in hosted for the pilot, we prefer Dedicated pilot > saying no. Keep updates here.
